changelog: **The e-mail composer's recipient list pages and searches on the server (#1438):** `GET /api/mentorship?view=recipients` is the composer's own narrow read: a relation id plus the mentee's name and language (no e-mail address), 50 per page, or every match of the search with `all=1` (capped at 2 000; `src/lib/boardPage.ts`). `/admin/email` and `/mentor/email` list one page with "Show more" and a recipient search. "Select all" picks every match of the current search and shows how many. A pick survives a change of search. The outcome prefill link asks for its one relation by id.

en: Writing to many mentees: the recipient list can be searched, and "Select all" picks everyone who matches the search.
tr: Çok sayıda mentee'ye yazarken alıcı listesinde arama yapabilirsiniz; "Tümünü seç" aramaya uyan herkesi seçer.
de: Beim Schreiben an viele Mentees ist die Empfängerliste durchsuchbar, und „Alle auswählen“ wählt alle, die zur Suche passen.
